goal: Explorable buildings with physical rooms, interactive doors and discoverable loot, inspired by DayZ interaction conventions without copying its assets.
appliesTo: Full 48x48 km world including City Sample downtown, snow metropolis, desert villages, forests and mountains
citySampleReality: Exterior modular facades cannot be treated as finished interiors. Actual doorway apertures, fitted interior modules, portals and collisions must be authored.

accessStrategy.minimumAccess: At least one physically traversable floor/room for each designated enterable building; no fake door on sealed exterior
accessStrategy.scalableHighriseRule: Only authored floors are accessible; never imply whole skyscraper interiors exist when they do not
accessStrategy.otherFloors: Physically restrict inaccessible floors with plausible barriers; optionally add independent streaming floors later
accessStrategy.distanceStreaming: Load interiors by proximity and unload when safely vacant; preserve persistence independently
accessStrategy.qualityTarget: SM5 Intel Iris Xe 16GB profile, no mandatory Nanite, low RAM and VRAM budgets, benchmark required

existingDoorFeatures: distance and line of sight validation
unverifiedOrMissing: fitted doors on City Sample facades
persistent door/loot state verified in PIE and build

acceptBeforeClaim.minimumStreetLevelBuildingCoverage: Target to be determined after full building inventory

prohibited: Do not pass visual exterior-only meshes as playable interiors
Do not claim every high-rise floor exists automatically
Do not change DRAZOVIA or other world packages
Do not publish licensed City Sample assets to public GitHub
